title: ReportHeader

Time.description: Specifies the time at which report was generated

ReportBasis.description: Specifies the report is cash basis or accrual basis

StartPeriod.description: Start Period for which the report was generated

EndPeriod.description: End Period for which the report was generated

Currency.description: Specifies the currency code associated with the report, note that this is one place where this is just the currency code, not a reference to a currency object

Customer.description: Specifies the customer id (comma separeted) for which the report is run this is just the id, not a reference to a customer object

Vendor.description: Specifies the vendor id (comma separeted) for which the report is run this is just the id, not a reference to a vendor object

Employee.description: Specifies the employee id (comma separeted) for which the report is run this is just the id, not a reference to a employee object

Item.description: Specifies the product/service id (comma separeted) for which the report is run this is just the id, not a reference to a product/service object

Class.description: Specifies the class id (comma separeted) for which the report is run this is just the id, not a reference to a class object

Department.description: Specifies the Department id (comma separeted) for which the report is run this is just the id, not a reference to a Department object

Option.description: Describes the options used for the report

description: Specifies the Header of a Report, Time report was generated, parameters corresponding to the request
